eligibility.rule: user must appear at least once on or before training_window_end; holdout activity is not used for selection

notes: These folds test unseen user identities after masking their user-level history and profile features. They are not true temporal new-user cohorts; use true_new_user_cohorts.csv as the complementary cold-start diagnostic. For aggregate-only models these folds have little value because the model does not consume user identity.
